capabilities: Chat with Claude or OpenAI-compatible models inside a note
Manage chat histories as plain notes with front matter options
Add notes as context using wikilinks
Format chats with headers or foldable callouts
Insert custom prompts via commands or slash commands
extras: Support for non-Claude models via OpenAI-compatible APIs is described as experimental and not fully tested; image embedding in prompts is planned but not implemented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with AI models or keep conversations as editable notes in the vault.

relations.evidence: Support custom API providers such as OpenRouter

requires.name: Anthropic API key or an OpenAI-compatible provider key

summary: AI chat plugin that lets you converse with Claude or OpenAI-compatible models directly inside notes, storing chats as plain Markdown notes.
